name: Condorcet
biography: Presented alongside Helvétius as a rationalist-revolutionary optimist, more influenced by Rousseau, who championed the rights of man, the equality of women, and admired the American and French Revolutions; Russell notes the irony of his optimism given his death in hiding from Robespierre.
